x: Use

Right mouse click on a jam-filled cooking pot/crock to obtain scoops of jam. Each serving yields 2 scoops of jam.

Some jam can't be scooped due to technical limitations, but in certain cases you can allow scooping anyway with a command. See this mod's ModDB page for more details.
Obtaining
Use a jam spoon to scoop jam from a cooking pot or crock.
